Rollout plan for the queue worker

Move the queue worker from cron to a long-running process in three steps.

Step Owner Weeks
Shadow traffic Priya 2
Cutover Sam 1
Decommission cron Priya 1

Risks

Duplicate delivery is the one that costs money.

  • Duplicate delivery on a retry after the visibility timeout
  • Queue depth during the shadow week
  • A cron entry nobody removed

Rollback

Trigger

Two consecutive minutes over 400 ms at the 99th percentile.

Command

deploy rollback queue-worker --to cron
The cron entry stays in place until the decommission step.
